name: Sphere Light Sampling with Multiple Strategies
definition: Calculates direct lighting from a spherical light source using Monte Carlo integration with various sampling strategies (Importance Solid Angle, Importance Surface Area, Uniform Solid Angle, etc.).
summary: Sphere Light Sampling with Multiple Strategies calculates direct lighting from spherical lights using Monte Carlo integration with various sampling strategies, distinguishing itself by explicitly handling spherical geometry through multiple distinct probability density functions.
